name: Shop email notifications
description: Sends order-related emails — customer order confirmation, customer payment-completed notification, admin new-order notification. Templates are overridable via the settings table (default templates are built-in). Requires the Shop plugin to fire its order hooks, and SMTP configured in Slate → Settings → Email.
